subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: If the feature has no meaningfully-automatable e2e surface — every required behavior routes to manual, or the feature is pure-doc/refactor with no end-to-end behavior to exercise, then the system shall produce no e2e documents and signal the operator that the feature has no automatable e2e surface (naming the reason) and that the downstream e2e steps (review, plan) must not run
intent: a refusal-style signal naming the no-automatable-surface reason; zero e2e documents produced; the pipeline does not advance to review or plan
fit_criterion: the no-automatable-surface fixtures (an all-manual feature and a pure-doc feature) each yield the stop-signal naming the reason and produce zero e2e documents; zero fabricated scenarios; zero plan produced
